title: Greeting the Teacher
subject: English Language
objectives: Greet the teacher politely in the morning
Respond correctly when the teacher asks 'How are you?'
Use the word 'sir' or 'ma' when talking to a teacher

blocks.alt: A teacher greeting students in a classroom
blocks.caption: The teacher greets the class in the morning.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: How are you all this morning?

lines.speaker: Pupils
lines.text: We are all fine, thank you sir.

lines.speaker: Ayo
lines.text: I am fine, sir, thank you.

blocks.md: **Remember:** When you talk to a male teacher, call him **'sir'**. When you talk to a female teacher, call her **'ma'**.

quiz.q: What do you say when you see your teacher in the morning?
quiz.explain: In the morning, we say 'Good morning'.

quiz.q: If your teacher asks 'How are you?', what is the best answer?
quiz.explain: When someone asks how you are, you say 'I am fine, thank you.'
